# SecureChat — StealthX Platform
> End-to-end encrypted messaging for Android.
> No phone number or account. The current alpha uses a central signaling relay that processes connection and routing metadata.
> XChaCha20-Poly1305 + Double Ratchet. Kaspa identity and decentralized relay discovery remain roadmap work.
> Source available for transparency and security review. Buy once, use forever. Sales are not open yet; purchases are unavailable until the VLABS shop goes live.

## Key Facts
- Encryption: XChaCha20-Poly1305 (192-bit nonce, AEAD)
- Key Exchange: X25519 ECDH (ephemeral per-session)
- Forward Secrecy: Double Ratchet (HKDF-SHA256, RFC 5869)
- Identity Signing: Ed25519
- Key Derivation: Argon2id (64MB memory, 3 iterations)
- Key Storage: Android Keystore (StrongBox/TEE)
- Identity Layer: Local Ed25519 identity; Kaspa anchoring is roadmap work
- Platform: Android 8.0+ (API 26)
- License: StealthX Source-Available License
- Crypto Library: lazysodium-android 5.2.0 (wraps libsodium)
- Database: Room + SQLCipher (encrypted at rest)
- Online Transport: Central signaling relay; Tor and decentralized relays are roadmap work
- Paid Access: Launch-gated; current public builds must not unlock from an unverified client purchase callback

## What Makes SecureChat Different
- No phone number required (unlike Signal, WhatsApp)
- Minimized account surface: no phone number or account registration
- End-to-end encrypted payloads; the signaling relay still processes routing and connection metadata
- STEALTH-DELETE: instant wipe of all data
- Paid tiers: one-time lifetime licences; sales are not open yet
- Part of the StealthX ecosystem (SecureCall, Chameleon)
